scope: TargetAlias resolution for the 37 alias families observed in the repaired external corpus, anchored by TaskContext target primitives from target_selector_batch_05.json. Filter masks, forced-target/taunt priority and legal-action enumeration remain separate packets.

evidence.support: E4 local evidence for TaskActionTarget, OwnerEntity, Caster, TargetFetchTaskActionTarget/Caster/None evaluators, collapse-single-target and GameEntity runtime identity.
1901 ModifierOwnerEntity, 754 ParamEntity, 192 Caster, 57 AllEnemy and 33 further alias families were enumerated from the repaired corpus.

selected_model.entity_identity: GameEntity.RuntimeID is the stable signed int32 entity identity; EntitySnapshot {entity_id, team light/dark/neutral, alive, selectable, position(row,column)} is the selected canonical view.
selected_model.direct_aliases: Caster, AbilityTargetEntity, DamageAttackerEntity, DamageDefenderEntity, CurrentTurnActionEntity, CurrentTurnOwnerEntity, ModifierOwnerEntity, SnapshotPropertyEntity, SnapshotEntityActualOwner, LevelEntity and SkillPointEntity resolve to the corresponding explicit context slot or empty.
selected_model.collection_aliases: AllEnemy and AllDarkTeam select enemy-team entities; AllLightTeam/AllTeammate select light-team entities; the WithUnselectable variants include non-selectable entities; alive filtering is always applied except where a packet explicitly says otherwise.
selected_model.list_aliases: ParamEntity/ParamEntity2/ParamEntityList, AbilityTargetList, AttackTargetList and SkillTargetEntityList preserve caller order and identity.
selected_model.adjacency: Adjoin aliases select same-team alive entities in the same row whose column differs by one from the center entity; diagonal adjacency is not selected.
selected_model.center: DarkTeamCenter resolves to the first dark-team entity in (row, column) order.
selected_model.ordering: Collection results are ordered by (position.row, position.column, entity_id). Direct aliases preserve exactly the source slot order; no random or floating order is introduced.
selected_model.unsupported: HimekoNova_00_AssistTarget, TeamFormation and any unseen alias reject explicitly until their special-mechanic packet exists.

unsupported_cases: filter masks and TargetFilter/TargetMapDynamicEntityParam operation semantics
summon / special-object aliases not present in the reviewed corpus
acceptance_fixture: tests/game_data/test_target_semantics_reference.py proves direct, collection, WithUnselectable, adjoin, center, payload extraction and explicit unsupported-alias rejection.
dsh_implementation_contract: Implement TargetAlias resolution with immutable entity snapshots and deterministic ordering. Unsupported aliases must reject the containing behavior, never resolve to empty or random targets.
